Interactive McLaren P1 — asset credits

Digital reconstruction of LEGO Technic set 42172 by Jens Brühl (jb70).
Source: https://bricksafe.com/files/jb70/42172-pimp-up-my-mclaren/omr/42172%20-%20McLaren%20P1.mpd
Source announcement: https://www.eurobricks.com/forum/forums/topic/199596-42172-mclaren-p1-mods-and-improvements/page/4/
Model license: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

Adaptation: converted into instanced browser geometry, normalized scale and orientation, and added cursor-controlled body-panel cutaway.
This is an independent fan adaptation, not an official LEGO digital model. LEGO and McLaren marks belong to their respective owners.
